name: v0.3.35 — app icon: Apple avocado mascot
releaseNotes:
• New app icon: Apple's avocado emoji on the GetGuac emerald-700 squircle background. Both the legacy icon (Android 5-7) and the adaptive icon (Android 8+) regenerated from the same source so every launcher gets the right thing.
• Web Connections: 'Link account directly' callout now visible on Amazon (and any retailer the mobile WebView can link). Routes to /download for the actual link since browser sandboxing blocks the flow on web.
